presentation.name: Translate a metric between SQL and DAX without changing the number
presentation.summary: Rewrites an existing metric from SQL into DAX or from DAX into SQL, and treats the result as unchecked until the same grain and filters return the same number.
benefits: Binds each SQL table, column, and date to a TMDL object before writing DAX, and copies those identifiers as they are written
Refuses a guessed formula when the grain, the filters, the date, or the bindings are not known
Writes the assumptions down and marks each binding as stated or assumed
Keeps a ratio, a snapshot, a time comparison, a join fan-out, a running total, and a conditional sum as different numbers from a plain sum
Keeps a visual's filter with KEEPFILTERS, and treats CASE without ELSE as a blank rather than a zero
Labels a translation unchecked when it cannot be run at the same grain, filters, and population
